localCoordinateSystem.drawingBasis: Proportional reconstruction from the supplied five hand-drawn floor plans. No written dimensions were present, so room dimensions and areas are approximate.

analysis.planLogic: Ground floor is asymmetric with a north-west canteen and south-east laboratories; floors 1-4 use a central east-west passage, central stair core, end stairs, and east-side lift projection.
analysis.coordinatePolicy: Do not repeat latitude/longitude per unit. Geometry is relative to georeference.
analysis.georeferencing: Applied user-supplied WGS84 structure footprint to the reconstructed local floor-plan geometry.
analysis.featureCoordinatePolicy: Feature coordinates remain local; no latitude/longitude is repeated per unit.
analysis.note: The footprint coordinates are treated as the authoritative real-world building envelope. Internal room boundaries remain reconstruction-derived from the supplied drawings.
